ordinaryPollinatorManagement.scope: Actual key edges, sampled swarm ownership and seven permanent receipt histories. Work/recovery observations use positive actual interval credits while playing, excluding frozen settlement samples. An active retarget-flight observation requires the current flight ID to match that actual retarget command; a past retarget receipt alone is not such an observation. Sparse gaps and unobserved last-operation updates remain explicit. No flight integration, flower scheduling or missing-tick replay is run. Menu pilot preparations are excluded from gameplay evidence.

actualDispatchBarrier.scope: Actual post-dispatch snapshots and the next decision tick, or an observed later terminal tick. Recipe/menu observations remain separate.

encodedObservationAnchors.scope: Nine unmodified encoded images selected only from actual periodic public observations: three menus, actual swarm flight after a permanent retarget receipt, credited pollination, returned-home positive recovery, same-field cooperative credits, completed fields while a swarm is still flying home, and terminal hold. The flight image does not claim to depict the same particular retarget segment. No post-dispatch edge selection or extra Model run. Every image semantic still awaits personal review; receipt timing is not an exact pixel-state alias.

artifactVerificationScope: Reuse the completed fetch verification of signature, alignment, CRC, manifest identity and signed assets; compare those exact signed asset hashes with the actual candidate build. No second signature or full ZIP verification run.
